name: dsh-workbuddy-connect
description: Vendored copy of dsh-workbuddy-connect's runtime, kept inside this plugin. See PROVENANCE.json and LICENSE in this directory.
_comment: Only `peerDependencies` is load-bearing here: DSH's profile resolver intercepts a bare import when the nearest package.json above the importing module declares that name as a peer. Without this manifest those imports fall through to native resolution and fail, because a linked plugin has no node_modules of its own.
